user_saw: With loop detection enabled, the agent could keep rediscovering the same tools or resuming unchanged work without triggering a warning or block.
summary: The fix compares Code Mode calls and outcomes using execution inputs, pending operations, and guest results while ignoring display titles and volatile receipt metadata.
reasoning: The earliest available snapshot already shows Code Mode emitting cumulative telemetry and pending bridge IDs and the detector hashing receipt content. Later diffs show that #138568 added display titles to the hashed arguments and #147278 added fresh reference IDs to oversized result receipts, each creating another way to evade detection. The available offline history stops before the original telemetry and bridge-ID behavior can be traced to an introducing commit or checked against an earlier working version.
